{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Silk blend blouse, relaxed fit, knee-length tunic, midnight blue (#000038), fine jersey.
High-waisted wide-leg trousers, tailored cut, ankle length, charcoal gray (#36454F), heavy wool crepe.
Structured blazer, single-breasted, hip length, forest green (#228B22), textured tweed.
Pointed-toe pumps, medium heel, classic silhouette, black (#000000), smooth patent leather.
Gold drop earrings, minimal stud style, dangling length to jawline, metallic finish, 18k gold plating.

This ensemble works perfectly for a formal autumn evening dinner by blending rich, seasonal textures like wool crepe and tweed with the fluid elegance of silk. The color palette of midnight blue, charcoal, and forest green feels sophisticated and celebratory without appearing too heavy for an indoor setting with artificial light. Since the role is that of a guest at a festive event where children are present, the relaxed fit blouse and wide-leg trousers offer comfort and ease while maintaining a polished look that respects the strict formality of the occasion."}
